Dear [Sir](/person/743)[^1]
I am very sorry if I did not answer your letter, and acknowledge the little book, I fully thought that I had done so.
I have gone quite half way in the [Life of Hannah More](/book/199).

If the requisite number of pages be not attained, I can easily shorten or lengthen the account of her works, but I think the length will be right.
I have the Mendip annals - i.e.

Patty More’s Journal, which I find very useful

Yours truly

C M Yonge		
I think I shall be able to send you the whole MS in less than a month


[^1]: John Henry Ingram (1842-1916) was editor of the ‘Eminent Women’ series for which CMY wrote Hannah More.
